changelog: Restored dropdowns for version, video, audio and subtitles in a compact media settings modal. Synchronised selections with Jellyfin playback and refreshed details safely when switching versions. Added a “Use custom SleekFin dropdown” option in configuration to show custom season and media setting dropdowns (default is to use native dropdown). Also removed duplicate Play/Resume buttons, reordered actions to Play/Resume, Download and Add to watchlist with a ⋮ settings button for media settings modal. Also simplified duplicated picker code and lifecycle cleanup. Changes by @T9es and @varunaditya-plus
description: The ultimate Jellyfin Web revamp, with new elements, styles, plus compatible with the most popular plugins.
